consent.title: Before you send

points.t: The photo and/or message you submit, plus a name only if you choose to type one. No account, email, or location is collected, and photos are re-saved without their hidden location data.

The event organizer reviews everything first. Approved items go to Kai, who keeps them as a thank-you gallery. Your photo may appear as one small tile inside a mosaic, and Kai may post the finished mosaic image on their social accounts.
Kai can hide or remove anything at any time, and can ask for the whole page to be wiped. You can delete your own submission whenever you like with the delete code shown after you send.
Everything is deleted automatically 30 days after the event closes, and never kept longer than 90 days.
Only upload photos you took or have permission to share, and avoid photos where bystanders are the main subject.

consent.checkbox: I took this photo or have permission to share it, I am 13 or older (or have a parent's OK), and I agree to the above.
